text:
DOSL7::slowdown
Description
Adds source IP extracted from current connection to greylist. TCP
slowdown will be applied according to supplied RATE (in percents)
and TIMEOUT (in seconds). A RATE represents amount of incoming
data packets to be dropped to perform slowdown.
Syntax
DOSL7
::
slowdown
<
rate
>
<
timeout
>
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
contains
"heavy.php"
}
{
DOSL7
::
slowdown
30
60
}
}
